title: Design Intern (Rockwall Corrugating)
note: Corrugated packaging design internship at a box plant for current college students in drafting, design, engineering or a related field.

facts.duties: Learn box specifications, styles and board grades; run the CAD table and help with corrugated packaging drafts; introduction to box graphics, routing and basic machine operations.
facts.requirements: Current college student in drafting, design, engineering or a related field; CAD familiarity preferred or a willingness to learn.
facts.apply: Apply through the Apply Now link on the Pratt careers posting (ADP).
